name: search_products
description: Search the product catalog and return the best-rated matching products.

upstream.description: Benchmark parameter: base URL of the upstream API.

latency_ms.description: Benchmark parameter: upstream response delay in milliseconds.

size.description: Benchmark parameter: upstream response size in bytes.

seed.description: Benchmark parameter: selects the generated catalog.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

in_stock_only.description: Only return products that are in stock.

reuse_connection.description: Benchmark parameter: keep the upstream connection alive across calls.
